Watson.look: A thin, sun-browned man of about thirty in a worn tweed suit, haggard face, left arm held stiffly; an army doctor back from Afghanistan.

Holmes.look: A tall, excessively lean man over six feet, sharp piercing eyes, thin hawk-like nose, hands blotted with ink and stained with chemicals; in a purple dressing-gown, a pipe in his hand.

Stamford.look: A young, well-dressed dresser at St. Bartholomew's Hospital; Watson's old acquaintance from Barts, portly, with a genial face.

Commissionaire.look: A stalwart, plainly-dressed man walking slowly down the street, a large blue envelope in his hand; a retired sergeant of Royal Marines.

Gregson.look: A tall, white-faced, flaxen-haired man with a notebook in his hand; a Scotland Yard detective, self-satisfied manner.

Lestrade.look: A lean, ferret-like man, sallow-faced and dark-eyed; a Scotland Yard detective, wiry and tenacious.

Rance.look: A tall, heavy constable in civilian clothes, off duty; a beat policeman from the E Division, rough-spoken.

Mrs. Hudson.look: The long-suffering landlady of 221B Baker Street, middle-aged, patient.

Wiggins.look: A small, dirty-faced urchin, the leader of the Baker Street Irregulars.

Old Woman.look: A very old, wrinkled woman hobbling along; wearing an old bonnet, squinting with aged eyes — actually Jefferson Hope in disguise.

Jefferson Hope.look: A tall, powerful man with a deeply lined, sun-browned face and fierce dark eyes; a cabman in a long brown overcoat, broad-shouldered, huge hands.
